title: National Talent Scholarship (Postgraduate)
intro: National Talent Scholarship (NTS) was launched by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) to support students pursuing a Master's degree in agriculture outside their state of domicile.
details: Launched by Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)
Applicable for ICAR-recognized Agricultural Universities
Student must pursue studies outside the state of domicile
benefits: ₹3,000 per month scholarship
Scholarship provided for the full postgraduate duration
No contingency grant is paid
eligibility: Applicant must be a postgraduate agriculture student
Must study outside the domicile state
Should not receive any other scholarship
Must maintain good academic performance and conduct

steps: Visit the ICAR NTA official website
Complete online registration
Fill the application form
Upload required documents
Submit the application

title: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates
intro: This scheme provides financial assistance to SC/ST students pursuing postgraduate studies in professional courses such as Engineering, Management, Pharmacy and Technology.
details: Scholarship for SC/ST postgraduate students
Applicable to professional courses like Engineering, Technology, Management and Pharmacy
Applicable in recognized Indian Universities and Institutions
benefits: ₹7,800 per month for ME/M.Tech students
₹4,500 per month for other professional postgraduate courses
Scholarship tenure limited to course duration (2–3 years)
No contingency grant provided
eligibility: Applicant must belong to SC or ST category
Must have completed graduation in a relevant discipline
Must be admitted to a full-time regular postgraduate professional course
Only first-year postgraduate students are eligible
Institution must be recognized by UGC / Central / State Government

steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal
Fill postgraduate scholarship application form
Upload required documents
Submit application online

title: Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
intro: Pragati Scholarship Scheme by AICTE provides financial assistance to girl students pursuing technical degree courses in AICTE-approved institutions.
details: Implemented by AICTE under Ministry of Education
Applicable for first-year and lateral-entry students
Maximum two girl children per family are eligible
Scholarship duration up to 4 years or 3 years for lateral entry
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum as lump sum
Can be used for fees, books, computer, software and equipment
eligibility: Applicant must be a girl student
Must be admitted to first year or lateral entry of a technical degree course
Family annual income must not exceed ₹8,00,000
Applicable for selected Union Territories and North Eastern States

steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal
Login using Application ID and password
Fill the application form
Upload required documents
Final submit the application
Track payment status via PFMS portal

title: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
intro: Nikshay Poshan Yojana provides monthly nutritional financial assistance to tuberculosis (TB) patients during the course of their treatment.
details: Launched in 2018 by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Applicable to TB patients registered on the Nikshay portal
Aims to improve treatment outcomes by addressing malnutrition
benefits: ₹1,000 per month financial assistance for each notified TB patient
eligibility: Patient must be diagnosed with tuberculosis (TB)
Patient must be notified on or after 1 April 2018
Patient must be registered on the Nikshay portal

steps: Patient submits Aadhaar-linked bank account details to TB health provider
Health staff enters details in Nikshay portal
Bank details validated via PFMS
Monthly incentive credited to the validated bank account

title: Coaching Scheme for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) & Minority Students
intro: This scheme provides financial assistance to universities and institutions for coaching SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and Minority students to improve access to higher education and competitive exams.
details: Provides coaching support at UG and PG levels
Includes coaching for competitive exams, NET and entry into services
Assistance provided to universities over and above general development grants
benefits: One-time non-recurring grant up to ₹5 lakh for equipment and learning material
Recurring assistance up to ₹7 lakh per year for coaching-related expenses
eligibility: Universities and colleges recognized under UGC Act
Institutions with sufficient SC, ST, OBC and Minority student strength
BPL general category students may also be considered in limited cases

steps: Institution submits proposal to UGC
UGC evaluates eligibility and proposal
Approved institutions receive financial assistance
Coaching programs are implemented by institutions

title: Seva Bhoj Yojna
intro: Seva Bhoj Yojna is a scheme by the Ministry of Culture to support charitable and religious institutions that provide free food to the public by reimbursing GST paid on selected food items.
details: Launched in August 2018 by the Ministry of Culture
Applicable across India
Supports institutions serving free food such as Langar, Prasad or Bhandara
Reimburses Central GST (CGST) and Central share of IGST paid on food items
Applications are accepted every month from 1st to 15th
benefits: Reimbursement of GST paid on raw food items like rice, wheat flour, pulses, sugar, edible oil and ghee
Helps reduce operational cost of free food services
Encourages charitable and religious food distribution
eligibility: Applicant must be a registered charitable or religious institution
Institution must be distributing free food for at least the last 3 years
Must serve free food to a minimum of 5,000 people per month
Institution should not be receiving similar financial assistance from any other government scheme
exclusion: Institutions blacklisted under FCRA or any Central/State Government Act are not eligible
documents: Invoices for purchase of raw food items

steps: Register the institution on NGO Darpan Portal (NITI Aayog)
Enroll on the CSMS portal of Ministry of Culture
Upload required documents and registration details
Obtain unique enrollment number from Ministry of Culture
Submit GST reimbursement claims through the portal
GST authorities verify and approve the claim
Reimbursement amount is released to the institution

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
category: Accident Insurance • Social Security • Bank Account Holders
intro: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is a government-backed accident insurance scheme that provides financial protection in case of accidental death or disability at a very low annual premium.
details: Launched by the Government of India to provide accident insurance coverage
Covers accidental death and permanent disability
Insurance coverage is valid for one year and renewable annually
Premium is auto-debited from the subscriber’s bank or post office account
benefits: ₹2,00,000 in case of accidental death
₹2,00,000 for total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet
₹1,00,000 for total and irrecoverable loss of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot
eligibility: Individual must be a bank or post office account holder
Age should be between 18 years and 70 years
Subscriber must give consent for auto-debit of premium
Sufficient balance must be maintained in the account

application.mode: Online / Offline (via Bank or Post Office)
steps: Visit the bank branch or post office where you have a savings account
Alternatively, download the PMSBY application form from the official website
Fill in the required details and submit the form to the bank or post office
Provide consent for auto-debit of annual premium
After successful enrolment, insurance coverage starts from 1st June

title: Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY)
intro: Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY) is a mandatory insurance scheme introduced by the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) to safeguard Indian emigrant workers, especially those under the Emigration Check Required (ECR) category, going abroad for employment.
details: Mandatory insurance scheme for Indian emigrant workers under ECR category
Applicable to workers going to notified ECR countries for overseas employment
Provides comprehensive insurance coverage irrespective of change in employer or job location
Insurance policy must be obtained before emigration clearance
Online policy issuance and renewal facility available
Aims at speedy settlement of insurance claims through simplified procedures
Certification by Indian Missions / Posts abroad is accepted for claim processing
benefits: ₹10,00,000 insurance cover in case of accidental death or permanent disability during overseas employment
Medical insurance cover up to ₹1,00,000 for injuries, sickness or diseases (maximum ₹50,000 per hospitalization)
Repatriation expenses covered for medically unfit workers or premature termination of employment (one-way economy airfare to India)
Family hospitalization in India covered up to ₹50,000 for spouse and first two dependent children up to 21 years of age
Maternity benefit for women emigrants available up to ₹50,000
Reimbursement of one-way return economy airfare for one attendant in case of accidental death or permanent disability of the insured
Legal expenses related to overseas employment disputes covered up to ₹45,000
Facility for online renewal of insurance policy
eligibility: Applicant must be an Indian emigrant cleared for overseas employment
Applicable to Emigration Check Required (ECR) passport holders
Age of the applicant should be between 18 and 65 years
Must be traveling to a notified ECR country for employment
documents: Medical Records (in case of injury or disability)
Police Report (in case of accidental death)
Certificate from Indian Embassy / Mission abroad
Disability Certificate issued by competent medical authority (for disability claims)

steps: Before applying, keep passport, visa, work permit and employment details ready
Choose an authorized insurance provider offering PBBY policy
Fill the online PBBY application form with personal and travel details
Select the insurance plan as per duration of overseas employment
Make payment through available online modes such as UPI, debit card, credit card or net banking
After successful payment, download and save the insurance policy certificate
Submit the insurance policy details during emigration clearance process
Policy can be renewed online if employment period is extended

title: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
intro: The National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme provides an opportunity to young scholars to gain practical exposure in advanced areas of communication and cyber security while contributing to the technical work of NCCS.
details: Internships are offered on a quarterly basis
Interns work with NCCS divisions under the guidance of senior officers
Focus areas include hardware security, source code analysis, cryptography, malware detection and network vulnerabilities
An orientation workshop is conducted at the beginning of the internship
Interns are required to submit a final report at the end of the internship
The total number of interns at any time shall not exceed 20
duration: Category II: Minimum 6 months, extendable up to 12 months with approval
eligibility: Category I: Indian students in 3rd or 4th year (pre-final/final year) of Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Communication, Telecommunication, IT, Computer Science or related disciplines with minimum 60% marks
Category II: Indian graduates or postgraduates in Electronics, Communication, Telecommunication, IT, Computer Science or related disciplines with minimum 60% marks
Students pursuing or having completed postgraduate degrees are also eligible under Category II
Relaxation in qualifications may be considered in deserving cases
Meeting minimum eligibility does not guarantee selection
documents: Proof of Date of Birth (Class 10 certificate)
Degree certificate (for Category II, if applicable)
CGPA to percentage conversion proof (if applicable)
Internship or work experience certificates (if available)

steps: Check the official NCCS notification for the relevant quarter
Download and fill the prescribed application form (Annexure-II)
Prepare CV and clearly mention areas of interest
Email the completed application to jtohq.nccs-dot@gov.in with a copy to adethq.nccs-dot@gov.in
Select the internship category (Category I or Category II) in the application
Shortlisted candidates may be called for interview (physical or telephonic)
Selected interns must submit a No Objection Certificate from their institution before joining

notes: Applications must be submitted in the quarter preceding the intended internship period
The internship does not guarantee employment with NCCS
No TA/DA will be provided for interviews or internship

title: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme

details: Internships are offered on a quarterly basis
Interns work under NCCS divisions and senior officers

Orientation workshop is conducted at the start of internship
Maximum 20 interns are engaged at any given time
benefits: Exposure to real-world cyber and telecom security projects
Guidance from senior government technical experts
Certificate of Internship on successful completion
Opportunity to publish technical report or paper
eligibility: Category I: Indian students in 3rd or 4th year of Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Communication, IT, Computer Science or related fields with minimum 60% marks
Category II: Indian graduates or postgraduates in Electronics, Communication, IT, Computer Science or related fields with minimum 60% marks
Qualification relaxation may be granted in deserving cases
Meeting eligibility criteria does not guarantee selection
documents: Degree certificate (for Category II, if applicable)
Internship or work experience certificates (if any)

steps: Check NCCS official notification for the relevant quarter
Download and fill the prescribed application form (Annexure-II)
Prepare CV and clearly mention preferred work areas
Email application to jtohq.nccs-dot@gov.in with CC to adethq.nccs-dot@gov.in
Mention internship category (Category I or II) in the application
Shortlisted candidates may be called for interview
Submit No Objection Certificate from institution before joining
